# Keep an assist session visible after the extension popup is reopened

## What & Why
The extension persists its state and offers JSON recovery, while the cockpit can import an observed session. A follow-up should make the reconnect path easier to verify and use when a popup closes during a multi-page application.

## Done looks like
- Reopening the popup restores the active tab's session summary and page history
- A user can export/import session status without changing profile or application milestones
- Origin changes and emergency-stop state remain visible after reconnect
